class Animal {
  name = "animal";
  static kind = "k";
  age!: number;
  opt?: string;
  constructor(public legs: number) {}
  speak() { return "..."; }
  get label() { return this.name; }
  set label(v: string) { this.name = v; }
  arrow = () => 1;
  #secret = 1;
  static sm() { return 1; }
}
class Dog extends Animal {
  y = super.name;
  describe() { return super.name + super.speak() + super.label; }
  a() { return super.legs; }
  b() { return super.age + (super.opt ?? ""); }
  c() { return super.arrow(); }
  static d() { return super.kind + super.sm(); }
  static e = super.kind;
  f() { super.name = "x"; }
  g() { const { name } = super.constructor as any; return name; }
  h() { return super["name"]; }
}
class Puppy extends Dog {
  i() { return super.name + super.describe(); }
}
console.log(new Dog(4).describe(), new Puppy(4).i());
abstract class Base {
  private p = 1;
  protected q = 2;
  declare r: number;
  abstract s: number;
  abstract m(): number;
}
class D extends Base {
  s = 1;
  m() { return 1; }
  a() { return super.p + super.q + super.r + super.s; }
  b = () => super.q;
  c() { return super.m(); }
}
console.log(new D().a());
